title: CreateExtractionAgentRequest
description: Request body for creating a new extraction agent.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new extraction agent.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project to create the agent in.

data_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the data to extract. If not provided, the schema can be inferred automatically from example files.

description.description: Optional description of the extraction agent.

prompt.description: Optional prompt to guide automatic schema inference from example documents.
